s.d: Ἐνώς (Heb. אֱנוֹשׁ), ὁ, Enos ([[genesis 4 26|Gen.4:26]]): [[luke 3 38|Luk.3:38]].† (AS)
ἐνωτίζομαι (οὖς), depon. mid., [in LXX chiefly for אָזַן hi. ;] to give ear to, hearken to: with accusative, [[acts 2 14|Act.2:14.]]† Also used for יָחַל שָׁמַע (AS)
Ἐνώχ (Heb. חֲנוֹךְ), ὁ, Enoch ([[genesis 5 18|Gen.5:18]]): [[luke 3 37|Luk.3:37]], [[hebrews 11 5|Heb.11:5]], Ju 14.† (AS)
ἕξ, οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl., six: [[matthew 17 1|Mat.17:1]], [[luke 13 14|Luk.13:14]], al. (AS)
ἐξ-αγγέλλω [in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;] to tell out, proclaim: [[1-peter 2 9|1Pe.2:9]] [[[mark 16 1|Mrk.16:1-20]], "shorter conclusion"] (Cremer, 29).† (AS)

ἐξ-αγοράζω [in LXX: καιρόν ὑμεῖς ἐξαγοράζετε (זְבַן), Dan LXX TH [[daniel 2 8|Dan.2:8]] * ;] 1. to redeem, ransom (esp. of slaves): metaphorically, [[galatians 3 13|Gal.3:13 4:5]]. 2. to buy up; mid., to buy up for oneself: τ. καιρόν, [[ephesians 5 16|Eph.5:16]], [[colossians 4 5|Col.4:5]] (Cremer, 60).† (AS)

ἐξ-άγω [in LXX chiefly for יָצָא hi. ;] to lead out: with accusative, [[mark 15 20|Mrk.15:20]], [[john 10 3|Jhn.10:3]], [[acts 5 19|Act.5:19 7:36 16:37-39]]; before ἔξω, [[luke 24 50|Luk.24:50;]] ἐκ, [[acts 7 40|Act.7:40 12:17 13:17]], [[hebrews 8 9|Heb.8:9]]; εἰς, [[acts 21 38|Act.21:38.]]† (AS)

ἐξ-αιρέω -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for נָצַל hi. ;] to take out: with accusative, ὀφθαλμόν, [[matthew 5 29|Mat.5:29 18:9]]; mid. (a) to take out for oneself, choose: [[acts 26 17|Act.26:17]] (Thayer, see word; Page, Ac., l.with, but see infr.); (b) to deliver: [[acts 7 10|Act.7:10, 34]]" (LXX) [[acts 12 11|Act.12:11]] [[acts 23 27|Act.23:27]] [[acts 26 17|Act.26:17]] (EV, but see supr.), [[galatians 1 4|Gal.1:4.]]† (AS)
ἐξ-αίρω [in LXX for נָסַע, יָרַשׁ hi., כָּרַת ni., מוּת, בָּעַר pi., etc. ;] to lift up, lift off the earth, remove: [[1-corinthians 5 13|1Co.5:13]] (LXX)† (AS)
ἐξ-αιτέω, -ῶ to ask from; mid., to ask for oneself, demand: aor., ἐξῃτήσατο, with accusative (obtained you by asking, R, mg.), [[luke 22 31|Luk.22:31]] (see Field, Notes, 76; Cremer, 73).† (AS)

ἐξ-αίφνης (WH, ἐξέφνης, exc. [[acts 22 6|Act.22:6;]] see App., p. 151, and cf. M, Pr., 35), adv. (ἄφνω), [in LXX chiefly for פִּתְאוֹם ;] suddenly [[mark 13 36|Mrk.13:36]], [[luke 2 13|Luk.2:13 9:39]], [[acts 9 3|Act.9:3 22:6]].† (AS)

ἐξ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ [in LXX [[amos 2 4|Amo.2:4]], [[jeremiah 2 2|Jer.2:2]] (אַחַר הָלַךְ), [[isaiah 56 11|Isa.56:11]] (פָּנָה), [[job 31 9|Job.31:9]] (פָּתָה ni.), Sir.5:2, Dan LXX TH [[daniel 3 1|Dan.3:1-30]] :(41) * ;] to follow, follow up (in various senses): metaphorically, [[2-peter 1 16|2Pe.1:16 2:2 2:15]] † (AS)
ἐξακόσιοι, -αι, -α. six hundred: [[revelation 13 18|Rev.13:18 14:20]].† (AS)

ἐξ-αλείφω [in LXX for טוּחַ, [[leviticus 14 42|Lev.14:42]], al.; metaphorically, מָחָה, שָׁחַת, etc. ;] 1. to plaster, wash over (LXX). 2. to wipe off, wipe out: δάκρυον, [[revelation 7 17|Rev.7:17 21:4]]; metaphorically, χειρόγραφον, [[colossians 2 14|Col.2:14;]] τ. ὄνομα, before ἐκ, [[revelation 3 5|Rev.3:5]] (MM, Exp., xiii); pass., ἀμαρτίαι (ἐξαλιφθῆναι, WH), [[acts 3 19|Act.3:19]] (cf. [[psalms 51 11|Psa.51:11]] [[psalms 109 13|Psa.109:13]], [[isaiah 43 25|Isa.43:25]], Sir.46:20 (ἁμ. ἀπαλ-), 3Ma.2:19).† (AS)
ἐξ-άλλομαι [in LXX for קָלַל ([[habakkuk 1 8|Hab.1:8]]), etc. ;] to leap up: [[acts 3 8|Act.3:8.]]† (AS)
ἐξ-ανάστασις, -εως, ἡ (ἐξανίστημι), a rising again: ἐκ τ. νεκρῶν, [[philippians 3 11|Php.3:11]] (Cremer, 308).† (AS)

ἐξ-ανα-τέλλω [in LXX: [[genesis 2 9|Gen.2:9]], [[psalms 104 14|Psa.104:14]] [[psalms 132 17|Psa.132:17]] [[psalms 147 8|Psa.147:8]] (צָמַח hi.); [[psalms 112 4|Psa.112:4]] (זָרַח) * ;] 1. trans., to cause to spring up (LXX). 2. Intrans. (as ἀνατέλλω, [[genesis 3 18|Gen.3:18]]), to spring up: [[matthew 13 5|Mat.13:5]], [[mark 4 5|Mrk.4:5]].† (AS)

ἐξ-ανίσημι [in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;] 1. trans., to raise up: σπέρμα (cf. [[genesis 38 8|Gen.38:8]]), [[mark 12 19|Mrk.12:19]], [[luke 20 28|Luk.20:28]]. 2. In 2 aor. act., intrans., to rise: [[acts 15 5|Act.15:5.]]† (AS)

ἐξ -απατάω, -ῶ strengthened form of ἀπατάω, [in LXX: [[exodus 8 29|Exo.8:29]] (הָתַל hi.), Da TH Sus 5:6* ;] to deceive: with accusative, [[romans 7 11|Rom.7:11]] [[romans 16 18|Rom.16:18]], [[1-corinthians 3 18|1Co.3:18]], [[2-corinthians 11 3|2Co.11:3]], [[2-thessalonians 2 3|2Th.2:3]]; pass., [[1-timothy 2 14|1Ti.2:14.]]† (AS)
ἐξάπινα = ἐξαπίνης, ἐξαίφνης (which see), [in LXX for פִּתְאוֹם, etc. ;] suddenly: [[mark 9 8|Mrk.9:8.]]† (AS)

ἐξ-απορέω, -ῶ [in LXX, pass., for פּוּן, [[psalms 88 15|Psa.88:15]] * ;] so in NT, depon. pass., to be utterly at a loss, be in despair: absol. (as Ps, l.with), [[2-corinthians 4 8|2Co.4:8;]] τοῦ ζῆν, [[2-corinthians 1 8|2Co.1:8.]]† (AS)

ἐξ-απο-στέλλω [in LXX freq., chiefly for שָׁלַח pi. ;] 1. to send forth: with accusative of person(s), [[acts 7 12|Act.7:12 12:11]], [[galatians 4 4|Gal.4:4]]; τ. ἐπαγγελίαν, [[luke 24 49|Luk.24:49;]] τ. πνεῦμα, [[galatians 4 6|Gal.4:6;]] [τ. κήρυγμα, [[mark 16 1|Mrk.16:1-20]], "shorter conclusion," WH ;] before εἰς, [[acts 22 21|Act.22:21;]] pass., ὁ λόγος, [[acts 13 26|Act.13:26.]] 2. to send away: with accusative of person(s), before εἰς, [[acts 9 30|Act.9:30;]] before ἕως, [[acts 11 22|Act.11:22;]] with inf., [[acts 17 14|Act.17:14;]] κενόν, [[luke 1 53|Luk.1:53 20:10-11]].† (AS)

ἐξ-αρτίζω (ἄρτιος), [in LXX. [[exodus 28 7|Exo.28:7]] (חָבַר pu.) * ;] 1. to com­plete, finish: τ. ἡμέρας, [[acts 21 5|Act.21:5.]] 2. to furnish, supply: pass., [[2-timothy 3 17|2Ti.3:17]] (for exx., see MM, Exp., xiii; Cremer, 651).† (AS)

ἐξ-αστράπτω [in LXX: [[numbers 3 3|Num.3:3]] (בָּרָק), [[ezekiel 1 4|Eze.1:4]] (לָקַח hithp.) 17 Dan LXX 106 (קָלַל)* ;] to flash like lightning, gleam, be radiant: ἱματισμός, [[luke 9 29|Luk.9:29.]]† (AS)

ἐξ-αυτῆς (a κοινή word, = ἐξ αὐτῆς τ. ὥρας) at once, forthwith: [[mark 6 25|Mrk.6:25]], [[acts 10 33|Act.10:33]] [[acts 11 11|Act.11:11]] [[acts 21 32|Act.21:32]] [[acts 23 30|Act.23:30]], [[philippians 2 23|Php.2:23]].† (AS)
ἐξ-εγείρω [in LXX for עוּר ni., hi., etc. ;] to raise up: [[romans 9 17|Rom.9:17]] (cf. ICC, in l); from the dead, [[1-corinthians 6 14|1Co.6:14.]]† (AS)
ἔξ-ειμι (εἶμι), to go forth: [[acts 13 42|Act.13:42]] [[acts 17 15|Act.17:15]] [[acts 20 7|Act.20:7]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, [[acts 27 43|Act.27:43.]]† (AS)
ἐξ-ελίγχω [in LXX [[proverbs 30 6|Pro.30:6]], [[micah 4 3|Mic.4:3]], [[isaiah 2 4|Isa.2:4]] (יָכַח hi.), Wis.12:17, 4Ma.2:12 * ;] to convict: Ju 15, Rec. (for ἐλέγχω, WH, which see).† (AS)
ἐξ-έλκω [in LXX: [[genesis 37 28|Gen.37:28]] (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;] to draw out or away: metaphorically, ὑπὸ τ. ἐπιθυμίας, [[james 1 14|Jas.1:14]] (see Mayor, in l).† (AS)
ἐξέραμα, -τος, τό (ἐξεράω, to evacuate, disgorge) a vomit: [[2-peter 2 22|2Pe.2:22]] (LXX).† (AS)
ἐξ-εραυνάω (Rec. ἐξερευνάω), -ῶ, [in LXX for חָקַר, נָצַר, etc. ;] to search out, search carefully: before περί, [[1-peter 1 10|1Pe.1:10.]]† (AS)

ἐξέρχομαι, [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for יצא, also for עלה ,בּוֹא, etc. ;] depon., to go, or come out of: [[matthew 10 11|Mat.10:11]], [[mark 1 35|Mrk.1:35]], [[john 13 30|Jhn.13:30]], al.; with inf., [[matthew 11 8|Mat.11:8]], [[mark 3 21|Mrk.3:21]], [[luke 7 25|Luk.7:25, 26]] [[acts 20 8|Act.20:8]]; id. before ἐπί, [[matthew 26 55|Mat.26:55]], al.; εἰς, [[mark 1 38|Mrk.1:38;]] ἵνα, [[revelation 6 2|Rev.6:2;]] ἐ. before ἐκ (cl. with genitive loc.), [[mark 5 2|Mrk.5:2]], [[john 4 30|Jhn.4:30]], al.; ἔξω, with genitive, [[matthew 21 17|Mat.21:17]], [[mark 14 68|Mrk.14:68]], [[acts 16 13|Act.16:13]], [[hebrews 13 13|Heb.13:13]]; ἀπό, [[mark 11 12|Mrk.11:12]], [[luke 9 5|Luk.9:5]], [[philippians 4 15|Php.4:15]]; ἐκεῖθεν, [[matthew 15 21|Mat.15:21]], [[mark 6 1|Mrk.6:1]], [[luke 9 4|Luk.9:4]], al.; of demons expelled, before ἐκ (ἀπό), with genitive of person(s), [[mark 1 25|Mrk.1:25, 26 5:8]], [[luke 4 35|Luk.4:35]], al.; of prisoners released, [[matthew 5 26|Mat.5:26]], [[acts 16 40|Act.16:40]]; ptcp., ἐξελθών, with indic., of verb of departure (cf. Dalman, Words, 20f.), [[matthew 8 32|Mat.8:32 15:21 24:1]], [[mark 16 8|Mrk.16:8]], [[luke 22 39|Luk.22:39]], [[acts 12 9|Act.12:9, 17]] al. Metaphorical, (a) of persons: [[2-corinthians 6 17|2Co.6:17]], [[1-john 2 19|1Jn.2:19]]; of birth or origin, [[matthew 2 6|Mat.2:6]] (LXX), [[hebrews 7 5|Heb.7:5]] (cf . [[genesis 35 11|Gen.35:11]]); of escape from danger, ἐκ τ. χειρὸς αὐτῶν, [[john 10 39|Jhn.10:39;]] of public appearance, [[1-john 4 1|1Jn.4:1;]] (b) of things: [[matthew 24 27|Mat.24:27;]] esp. of utterances, reports, proclamations: φωνή, [[revelation 16 17|Rev.16:17 19:5]]; φήμη, [[matthew 9 26|Mat.9:26]], [[luke 4 14|Luk.4:14]]; ἀκοή, [[mark 1 28|Mrk.1:28;]] λόγος, [[john 21 23|Jhn.21:23;]] δόγμα, [[luke 2 1|Luk.2:1]] (cf. δι-εξέρχομαι). (AS)

ἔξ-εστι (εἰμί), impers. verb., it is permitted, lawful: [[mark 2 24|Mrk.2:24]], [[acts 8 37|Act.8:37]] (R, mg.), [[1-corinthians 10 23|1Co.10:23;]] with inf., [[matthew 12 2|Mat.12:2, 10 12 14:4 15:26 19:3 22:17 27:6]], [[mark 3 4|Mrk.3:4 12:14]], [[luke 6 2|Luk.6:2, 9 14:3]], [[john 5 10|Jhn.5:10]]; before accusative, [[mark 2 26|Mrk.2:26]], [[luke 6 4|Luk.6:4 20:22]]; with dative of person(s) and inf., [[matthew 20 15|Mat.20:15]], [[mark 6 18|Mrk.6:18 10:2]], [[john 18 31|Jhn.18:31]], [[acts 16 21|Act.16:21 21:37 22:25]] (inf. understood), [[1-corinthians 6 12|1Co.6:12;]] ἐξόν (sc. ἐστί), [[acts 2 29|Act.2:29]], [[2-corinthians 12 4|2Co.12:4]]; ἐξὸν ἦν, [[matthew 12 4|Mat.12:4.]]† (AS)

ἐξ-ετάζω (ἐτάζω (rare), to examine), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 13 14|Deu.13:14-15]] [[deuteronomy 19 18|Deu.19:18]], [[1-chronicles 28 9|1Ch.28:9]] A (דָּרַשׁ), דָּרַשׁ), [[psalms 11 5|Psa.11:5-6]] (בָּחַן), Wis.6:3, Sir.3:21, al. ;] to examine closely, inquire carefully (of ): before περί (with ἀκριβῶς), [[matthew 2 8|Mat.2:8;]] before τίς, [[matthew 10 11|Mat.10:11;]] with accusative of person(s), [[john 21 12|Jhn.21:12.]]† SYN.: ἀνακρίνω, ἐραυνάω (see DCG, ii, 594b) (AS)

ἐξ-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι [in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;] to lead, show the way; metaphorically, to unfold, narrate, declare: with accusative of thing(s), [[luke 24 35|Luk.24:35]] [[acts 21 19|Act.21:19]]; with dative of person(s), [[acts 10 8|Act.10:8;]] θεόν (understood), [[john 1 18|Jhn.1:18;]] before ὅσα, [[acts 15 12|Act.15:12;]] καθώς, [[acts 15 14|Act.15:14.]]† (AS)

ἑξήκοντα, οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl., sixty: [[matthew 13 8|Mat.13:8, 23]], [[mark 4 8|Mrk.4:8, 20]], [[luke 24 13|Luk.24:13]], [[1-timothy 5 9|1Ti.5:9]], [[revelation 11 3|Rev.11:3]] [[revelation 12 6|Rev.12:6]] [[revelation 13 18|Rev.13:18]].† (AS)

ἑξῆς adv. (ἔχω), in order, successively, next: τῇ ἑ. ἡμέρᾳ, [[luke 9 37|Luk.9:37;]] ἐν τῷ ἑ. (sc. χρόνῳ), soon after, [[luke 7 11|Luk.7:11;]] τῇ ἑ. (sc. ἡμέρα), [[acts 21 1|Act.21:1]] [[acts 25 17|Act.25:17]] [[acts 27 18|Act.27:18]].† (AS)
ἐξ-ηχέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[joel 3 14|Jol.3:14]] (הָמוֹן), Sir.40:13, 3Ma.3:2 * ;] to sound forth (as a trumpet, or thunder; see M, Th., l.with): pass., [[1-thessalonians 1 8|1Th.1:8.]]† (AS)
ἐξις, -εως, ἡ (ἔχω), [in LXX, cf. Sir, prol.9 ;] habit, use, experience: [[hebrews 5 14|Heb.5:14.]]† (AS)

ἐξ-ίστημι (also in Hellenistic -ιστάνω, [[acts 8 9|Act 8:9]]), [in LXX for H2730, etc. (29 words in all) ;], 1. causal in Pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put out of its place; metaphorically, ἐ. τινά φρενῶν (Eur.), to drive one out of his senses, hence, absol., to confound, amaze: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 24 22|Luk.24:22]], [[acts 8 9|Act.8:9, 11]]. 2. Intr. in pass. and mid., also in 2 aor., pf., plpf. act., before ἐκ or with genitive, to stand aside from, retire from; esp. τ. φρενῶν, to lose one's senses (Eur.), hence, absol.; (a) to be beside oneself, be mad: [[mark 3 21|Mrk.3:21]], [[2-corinthians 5 13|2Co.5:13]] (opposite to σωφρονεῖν); (b) to be amazed, confounded: [[matthew 12 23|Mat.12:23]], [[mark 2 12|Mrk.2:12]] [[mark 5 42|Mrk.5:42]] [[mark 6 51|Mrk.6:51]], [[luke 2 47|Luk.2:47]] [[luke 8 56|Luk.8:56]], [[acts 2 7|Act.2:7, 12]] [[acts 8 13|Act.8:13]] [[acts 9 21|Act.9:21]] [[acts 10 45|Act.10:45]] [[acts 12 16|Act.12:16]] (Cremer, 309).† (AS)
ἐξ-ισχύω [in LXX: Sir.7:6 * ;] to have strength enough, to be quite able: with inf., [[ephesians 3 18|Eph.3:18.]]† (AS)
ἔξ-οδος, -ου, ὁ (ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹצָא also חוּץ, etc. ;] a going out, departure: [[hebrews 11 22|Heb.11:22;]] of death, [[luke 9 31|Luk.9:31]], [[2-peter 1 15|2Pe.1:15]].† (AS)
έξ-ολεθρεύω (so best MSS. and WH; also read -οθρεύω), [in LXX frequently (rare in Gk. writers) for כָּרַת ni., hi., etc. ;] to destroy utterly: before ἐκ τ. λαοῦ, [[acts 3 23|Act.3:23]] (LXX).† (AS)

ἐξ-ομολογέω, -ῶ and depon. mid., -έομαι, -οῦμαι [as always in LXX chiefly for יָדָה hi. ;] 1. act. = cl. ὁμολογέω, to profess or agree to do (Field, Notes, 75): [[luke 22 6|Luk.22:6.]] 2. Mid., to acknowledge, confess (MM, Exp., xiv): τ. ἁμαρτίας, [[matthew 3 6|Mat.3:6]], [[mark 1 5|Mrk.1:5]], [[james 5 16|Jas.5:16]]; τ. πράξεις, [[acts 19 18|Act.19:18;]] before ὅτι, [[philippians 2 11|Php.2:11;]] with dative of person(s), to make acknowledgment to one's honour, to praise, give praise to (as in LXX; Kennedy, Sources, 118): [[romans 14 11|Rom.14:11]](LXX) [[romans 15 9|Rom.15:9]] (LXX); before ὅτι, [[matthew 11 25|Mat.11:25]], [[luke 10 21|Luk.10:21]] (Cremer, 771).† (AS)

ἐξ-ορκίζω (later form of ἐξορκόω ), [in LXX: [[judges 17 2|Jdg.17:2]] (אָלָה), [[genesis 24 3|Gen.24:3]], [[1-kings 22 16|3Ki.22:16]] (שָׁבַע hi.)* ;] 1. to administer an oath to (Dem., Polyb., al.). 2. to adjure: with accusative of person(s), before κατά, with genitive (as frequently in magic π.; MM, Exp., xiv), [[matthew 26 63|Mat.26:63.]]† (AS)
ἐξ-ορκιστής, -οῦ, ὁ (ἐξορκίζω), 1. one who administers an oath. 2. an exorcist: [[acts 19 13|Act.19:13.]]† (AS)

ἐξ-ορύσσω [in LXX: [[proverbs 29 22|Pro.29:22;]] ὀφθαλμόν (-ούς), [[judges 16 21|Jdg.16:21]], [[1-samuel 11 2|1Ki.11:2]] (נָקַר)* ;] to dig out, dig up: στέγην, [[mark 2 4|Mrk.2:4;]] metaphorically, ὀφοαλμούς (cf. LXX, ll with; Herod., viii, 116), [[galatians 4 15|Gal.4:15.]]† (AS)
ἐξ-ουδενέω (Rec. -όω; T, -θανόω), -ῶ, [in LXX (with vv. ll. -όω, -θενέω, -θενόω) for בּוּז, בָּזָה, מָאַס, בּוּס, etc. ;] to despise, set at nought: [[mark 9 12|Mrk.9:12]] (cf. ἐξουθενέω).† (AS)

ἐξ-ουθενέω, -ῶ (οὐθείς, which see), [in LXX (see: ἐξουθενέω): [[1-samuel 2 30|1Ki.2:30]], al., and as seel. for -δενέω, -όω, -θενόω* ;] to set at nought, despise utterly, treat with contempt: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 18 9|Luk.18:9 23:11]], [[romans 14 3|Rom.14:3, 10]], [[1-corinthians 16 11|1Co.16:11]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[galatians 4 14|Gal.4:14]], [[1-thessalonians 5 20|1Th.5:20]]; pass., of persons: [[mark 9 12|Mrk.9:12]] (T, -όω), [[1-corinthians 6 4|1Co.6:4;]] of things λίθος, [[acts 4 11|Act.4:11]] (LXX ἀπεδοκίμασαν); λόγος, [[2-corinthians 10 10|2Co.10:10;]] τὰ ἐξουθενημένα, [[1-corinthians 1 28|1Co.1:28.]]† SYN.: ἀθετέω, καταφρονέω (see DCG, i, 453b) (AS)

ἐξουσία, -ας, ἡ (ἔξεστι), [in LXX: 4Ki.20:13, Psa.113 (114):2 135 (136)8, 9, [[isaiah 39 2|Isa.39:2]], Jer.28 (51):28 (מֶמְשָׁלָה), frequently in Da for Aram. שָׁלְטָן, etc., Wis.10:14, Sir.9:13, al. ;] 1. prop., liberty or power to act, freedom to exercise the inward force or faculty expressed by δύναμις (which see): [[1-corinthians 9 12|1Co.9:12;]] ἐ. ἔχειν, [[2-thessalonians 3 9|2Th.3:9;]] id. before inf., [[john 10 18|Jhn.10:18]], [[1-corinthians 9 4|1Co.9:4]], 5; with genitive obj., [[romans 9 21|Rom.9:21;]] before ἐπί, with accusative, [[revelation 22 14|Rev.22:14;]] περί, [[1-corinthians 7 37|1Co.7:37.]] 2. Later (cf. Milligan, Th., 114; MM, Exp., xiv), of the power of right, authority: [[matthew 21 33|Mat.21:33]], [[mark 11 28|Mrk.11:28]], [[luke 20 2|Luk.20:2]]; of Messianic authority, [[matthew 9 6|Mat.9:6]], [[mark 2 10|Mrk.2:10]], al.; of apostolic authority, [[2-corinthians 10 8|2Co.10:8 13:10]]; of the authority of government: [[matthew 8 9|Mat.8:9 28:18]], Ju 25, [[revelation 12 10|Rev.12:10]], al.; esp. of judicial authority, [[luke 20 20|Luk.20:20]], [[john 19 10|Jhn.19:10, 11]]. 3. Meton., (a) jurisdiction: [[luke 23 7|Luk.23:7]] (cf. 1Ma.6:11, [[isaiah 39 2|Isa.39:2]]); (b) a ruler or magistrate: [[romans 13 1|Rom.13:1-3;]] pl., [[luke 12 11|Luk.12:11]], [[romans 13 1|Rom.13:1]], [[titus 3 1|Tit.3:1]]; (with) of supramundane powers (syn. with ἀρχή, δύναμις, θρόνος, κυριότης): [[1-corinthians 15 24|1Co.15:24]], [[ephesians 1 21|Eph.1:21 3:10]], [[colossians 2 10|Col.2:10]], [[1-peter 3 22|1Pe.3:22]], al. ἐξ-ωθέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for נָדָה hi. ;] 1. to thrust out: [[acts 7 45|Act.7:45.]] 2. to drive out of the sea, drive on shore: [[acts 27 39|Act.27:39]] (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).† *ἐκ-σώζω, to preserve from danger, bring safe: [[acts 27 39|Act.27:39]] (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).† ἐξ-ωθέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for נָדָה hi. ;] 1. to thrust out: [[acts 7 45|Act.7:45.]] 2. to drive out of the sea, drive on shore: [[acts 27 39|Act.27:39]] (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).† *ἐκ-σώζω, to preserve from danger, bring safe: [[acts 27 39|Act.27:39]] (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).† (AS)

ἐπ-αύριον, adv. [in LXX for מָחָר, [[genesis 30 33|Gen.30:33]], elsewhere, [[exodus 9 6|Exo.9:6]], al., for מׇחֳרָת ;] on the morrow: in NT, ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἡμέρα), [[matthew 27 62|Mat.27:62]], [[mark 11 12|Mrk.11:12]], [[john 1 29|Jhn.1:29]], [[acts 10 9|Act.10:9]], al (AS)
